sections.name: summary
sections.value: No roadmap step; these keep CI trustworthy and close notes the verdict seats left. AC1 to AC3 are independent and start now. AC4 needs #131 merged, AC5 needs #129 merged and AC6 needs #132 merged; do them in that order as each lands. Every build is niced (nice -n 19 taskpolicy -b just shared-build). Tests that time real child processes may run nice-only (prime, 06 Nov).

sections.name: goals
value: Follow-ups from the 06 Nov roadmap push: fix the CI flakes (F27), make real-child timing tests honest under background QoS (F28), put the skill check in the gate (F26), and land three non-blocking verdict notes from #129, #131 and #132.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Anything another roadmap step owns; see roadmap 001.

value.claim: F27, flakes. Each of these is fixed at its root cause (or, if the cause is outside pij, made deterministic with a named reason): claude_heal_scripts copilot_status_line_hands_the_payload_to_pij_rs_in_one_process (BrokenPipe writing a child's stdin: treat EPIPE after the child has read its payload as success); pane_observer real_tmux; pij-cli claude_inbound daemon_boot_repairs_once_and_publishes_one_change_event (an isolated daemon child exits non-zero); the TS watchdog smoke's private-daemon teardown (exit null); the reaper tests under load.

F28, timing under QoS. Tests that measure real child processes against a wall-clock budget read one test-only scale (for example PIJ_TEST_TIME_SCALE, default 1) so a slow, niced machine stretches the budget instead of failing, and production budgets are untouched. The nice-only rule for such tests is written in AGENTS.md and the shared-build doc.

F26, the skill check. harness/scripts/pij-skill-check.sh passes on main: each of its 20 failing checks is fixed or retired with a reason, and it runs in `harness checks` and `just self-check` (a new sensor in .harness/extensions/checks/).

#131 N002 (after #131 merges). The delivery card's recorded_by comes from the same row as its recorded_at (the newest record for that PR), so a retry by a different recorder is attributed to that recorder.

#129 digest scope (after #129 merges). The PA digest reads only queued rows for the PA's projects (from its open assignments), without bodies, with a prime-only fallback across all projects; the 'delivering' rows stay visible.

#132 late admission (after #132 merges). When a memory turn ends at the bound while its prompt is still being admitted, the turn awaits the owned admission's settle after the held action and records admission delivered-late, queued or refused in memory.turn. Nothing is withdrawn; the record is honest.

Cost (AGENTS.md, resource cost is a correctness property). AC1 to AC3 change tests and the gate only; no production launch. AC4 and AC5 are single indexed reads replacing existing ones. AC6 adds one awaited future per bound-ended turn; no timer, poll or launch.

Docs and states. No roadmap state changes (follow-ups). docs/difficulties.md records F26, F27 and F28 as resolved. docs/how/pij-rs-api.md documents new verbs and refusals; the skill's verb coverage tables carry them; `just ddocs-check` and `ddocs validate` on the project docs pass; the PR body has a `Delivers:` line.

Ledger items docs/difficulties.md gives plan 209 (and pm-001 18:15): F31 (memory add prints one line); F34 (slug at most 40, cut on a word); F35, F38 (add --help marks required flags, shows the shortest add, says each add commits); F36, F37 (a role refusal lists every gap with the flag that fills it, no hand edit); F40 (the foreign-edit refusal says the prime commits); F46 (an unparsable Delivers line is quoted with the form to write); F48 (shared-build stops cargo on HUP); F51 (the memory prompt asks for one note); F26 in CI. F30, F41-F44, F49 and F50 are resolved by plan 213 (#147), which hands these verbs to pij-rs; F32 lands in the #138 merge with main.

value.risk: Two lanes edit the same CLI wiring or skill files.
value.mitigation: Rebase onto main before the PR; small diffs at the seam; pm-001 orders merges.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
